workflows.name: Search and transfer Allegro person/payment data
workflows.description: The Vue client searches hard-coded records, retains a clicked person and optionally clicked beneficiary, and sends a textfield-target WebSocket message through the Node broadcast relay to the separate Java Swing receiver.
workflows.trigger: The user enters any search criteria and clicks Suchen.

steps.name: Start search
steps.description: The user initiates a search from the Vue form.

steps.name: Enter criteria and click Suchen
steps.description: The form supports last name, first name, postal code, city, street, and house number.

steps.name: Search local fixtures
steps.description: Clear prior search results and scan the in-memory sample list. Populated criteria use OR matching; text checks are case-insensitive substrings and postal code uses equality.

steps.name: Any fixture records match?
steps.description: A match exists if any record satisfies any populated supported criterion; empty criteria match nothing.

steps.name: Display matching records
steps.description: Render matching fixture rows for user selection.

steps.name: Display empty result list
steps.description: No rows are added when no fixture matches. The transfer button remains available.

steps.name: Does the user click a result row?
steps.description: Clicking a row updates selected_result. The code does not require a fresh selection before transfer; a prior selection can remain, or the initial value can be empty.

outgoing_conditions.condition: User does not click a result

steps.name: Select person result
steps.description: Store the clicked record as selected_result and show its payment rows.

steps.name: Does the user click a payment row?
steps.description: Payment selection is optional in the implementation. No effective-date or bank-detail validation is performed.

outgoing_conditions.condition: User does not click a beneficiary row

steps.name: Select payment beneficiary
steps.description: Store the clicked beneficiary object; its valid_from date is displayed and passed through but not evaluated.

steps.name: Keep current beneficiary state
steps.description: No default beneficiary or selection guard runs. The transfer uses the current selected-beneficiary value, which may be empty or left from an earlier selection.

steps.name: Continue without a fresh person selection
steps.description: The transfer button does not check that a result was selected; selected_result may be empty or retain an earlier value.

steps.name: Click Nach ALLEGRO übernehmen
steps.description: Initiate transfer from the current selection state.

steps.name: Build and send textfield message
steps.description: Deep-copy selected_result, replace its payment list with the current selected beneficiary, and send JSON over the WebSocket.

steps.name: Broadcast message
steps.description: Relay the received UTF-8 message to every connected WebSocket client.

steps.name: Map recognized values into Swing fields
steps.description: For target textfield, parse name, first name, date of birth, ZIP, city, street, house number, IBAN, BIC, and valid-from into the receiver form.

steps.name: Transfer handled
steps.description: The receiving Swing fields are populated with recognized message values; absent values are not validated as business errors.

scope_notes: Search is local to embedded sample records; no search API or persistence is implemented.
The Vue component does not clear selected_result or the selected beneficiary when a new search is run or a different person is clicked.
Transfer can be attempted without a person or beneficiary selection.
The Java receiver maps only the listed subset of fields.

workflows.name: Relay Vue textarea edits to Swing
workflows.description: Each Vue textarea model change sends a textarea-target WebSocket message; the Node relay broadcasts it and the Java receiver writes the content into its text area.
workflows.trigger: The user changes the Vue textarea while the WebSocket is usable.

steps.name: Textarea edit begins
steps.description: The user edits the Vue textarea bound to internal_content_textarea.

steps.name: Observe model change
steps.description: The Vue watcher calls sendMessage with the new value and target textarea.

steps.name: Send WebSocket message
steps.description: Serialize a target/content JSON object and send it on the current socket.

steps.name: Broadcast UTF-8 message
steps.description: The Node server forwards the message to all connected clients.

steps.name: Update Swing text area
steps.description: The Java receiver recognizes target textarea and sets the text area content.

steps.name: Textarea content relayed
steps.description: The receiver text area reflects the message content.

scope_notes: There is no debounce, persistence, offline queue, or business-level send-error feedback.
The Vue client defines an onopen handler but no user-facing recovery for send failure.

workflows.name: Submit and reset the com.poc Swing form
workflows.description: The com.poc presenter binds Swing fields to a model, serializes all model properties as strings, posts JSON to localhost:8080/post, then displays a response event and resets visible inputs when the request returns normally.
workflows.trigger: The user clicks Anordnen in the com.poc Swing form.
participants: External or locally supplied POST endpoint (implementation absent)

steps.name: Form submission starts
steps.description: The com.poc view's submit button invokes its presenter listener.

steps.name: Keep model synchronized with controls
steps.description: Document and radio-button listeners update model values; the gender controls are mutually exclusive and the view initially selects female.

steps.name: Attempt to serialize every model property
steps.description: Iterate ModelProperties and call toString on each stored field while constructing a string-valued map. A null value throws during this operation; the following gateway represents whether conversion completes.

steps.name: Did serialization complete without a null value?
steps.description: This is an implicit technical precondition caused by toString, not user-facing required-field validation.

outgoing_conditions.condition: A null value caused conversion to throw

steps.name: Serialization fails before request
steps.description: Null conversion throws during serialization before HttpBinService is called; no validation message is emitted.

steps.name: POST JSON to /post
steps.description: HttpBinService sends application/json to http://localhost:8080/post and reads the response input stream.

steps.name: Did the request return a response body normally?
steps.description: Transport/HTTP errors may throw before the model emits an event; response status is not used to determine success.

outgoing_conditions.condition: Request returns normally with a readable body

steps.name: Request failure propagates
steps.description: The model does not convert the thrown request error into its normal response event; presenter catches and rethrows checked failures.

steps.name: Is the returned response body non-empty?
steps.description: The model chooses event text based on body emptiness, without checking HTTP success status.

steps.name: Emit response body
steps.description: Emit the body string to the in-process event emitter.

steps.name: Emit Failed operation
steps.description: Emit the literal Failed operation for an empty body returned normally by the service.

steps.name: Display event and reset form
steps.description: The presenter writes event text into the text area, clears text fields, and restores female selection.

steps.name: Feedback displayed
steps.description: Normal return path has displayed the event and reset the controls.

scope_notes: The Swing client flow and POST request construction are implemented, but this repository does not contain the localhost:8080 endpoint implementation.
HttpBinService uses getInputStream and Scanner.next; an HTTP error or empty stream can fail before the model's empty-body branch.
A distinct websocket.Main prototype has an Anordnen button whose handler only prints a message; it does not submit this form.

workflows.name: Cucumber POST API contract test
workflows.description: The Cucumber/RestAssured test client prepares complete, partial, empty, or fixture-based update data, sends a POST to an external endpoint, and asserts expected status/content/body behavior. These are test expectations, not endpoint behavior implemented in this repository.
workflows.trigger: A Cucumber scenario for the Allegro PoC POST API is executed.

steps.name: Run API scenario
steps.description: Cucumber creates scenario state and clears its in-memory request map.

steps.name: Prepare scenario request data
steps.description: Populate fields from a data table, choose an empty object, or load a named local fixture and apply updates.

steps.name: Is the request map empty?
steps.description: The test client chooses between its explicit {} request helper and the map-based JSON POST helper.

steps.name: POST empty JSON object
steps.description: ApiClient sends the literal {} to the configured /post path.

steps.name: POST scenario JSON fields
steps.description: ApiClient sends the populated request map as JSON to /post.

steps.name: Did the request return a response?
steps.description: An exception during the RestAssured call aborts the scenario before response assertions.

outgoing_conditions.condition: Request failed before a response was available

steps.name: Assert response expectations
steps.description: Depending on the scenario, assert HTTP 200, response values/body substrings, or JSON content type. Scenarios include complete, first/last-name-only, and empty-object requests.

steps.name: Did the external response satisfy assertions?
steps.description: This outcome depends on the external endpoint response; endpoint behavior is not implemented by this repository.

outgoing_conditions.condition: External response does not meet scenario assertions or request fails

steps.name: Scenario passes
steps.description: The configured external service satisfied this scenario's assertions.

steps.name: Scenario fails
steps.description: The endpoint response did not meet the test's expectations or the request could not complete.

scope_notes: The Cucumber project contains test client and assertions, not an API server; no successful endpoint response is source-proven.
The step named previously submitted loads a local fixture into the current scenario map; it does not submit a prior request or prove persistence.
The response-body assertion checks submitted values as substrings.

api.yml describes a request body with a nested user property, while the Java client sends a top-level map (or {}); the artifact and test payload expectations are not demonstrated as a single implemented contract.
